title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Medical equipment preparers
evidence: Medical equipment preparers entry reports high school diploma/equivalent and moderate-term on-the-job training; 2025 employment 79,900; May 2025 median $47,700; 2025–35 growth 11%, 8,700 additional jobs. Broader category, not a sterile-processing-only estimate.
baselineRecord: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Medical Equipment Preparers
2025 median wage $47,700, 2025–2035 projected growth 11%, high school entry and on-the-job training

title: O*NET OnLine — Medical Equipment Preparers (31-9093.00)
evidence: Occupation includes instrument cleaning and sterilization, equipment checks, records, distribution, attention to detail, manual tasks and work context. Updated 2026.
baselineRecord: Occupation tasks, knowledge, employment conditions and wage grouping

title: FDA — Reprocessing of Reusable Medical Devices
evidence: Reprocessing is multistep cleaning followed by disinfection or sterilization; retained soil can undermine later processing. Follow device labeling.

title: CDC — Recommendations for Disinfection and Sterilization
evidence: Cleaning before high-level disinfection/sterilization, protective equipment, monitoring and records; supports illustrative problems, not a universal daily schedule. Page Dec 7 2023 summarizes 2008 guideline.

title: CDC — Sterilizing Practices
evidence: Separate decontamination from clean packaging/storage; inspection, packaging, processing and monitoring all contribute to safe delivery. Page Nov 28 2023; avoid using old facility numerical specifications.

title: HSPA — Certified Registered Central Service Technician
evidence: Exam plus 400 documented hours; full route hours within prior five years, provisional documentation within six months; paid or volunteer; HSPA does not provide placement.
baselineRecord: 400 required experience hours and certification examination routes

title: CBSPD — SPD Technician Certification Exam
evidence: Four alternate eligibility routes; course grade at least 70 is an eligibility route, not certification by itself; passing exam required. Facility settings include hospitals, clinics, dental offices and surgery centers.
baselineRecord: Alternative eligibility routes and credentialing requirements

title: HSPA — Certified Instrument Specialist
evidence: Full current CRCST plus 200 additional hands-on hours and exam; article omits detailed hour breakdown.

title: HSPA — Certified Endoscope Reprocessor
evidence: Standalone credential without CRCST prerequisite; three months qualifying experience and exam; reprocessing includes device testing, cleaning, disinfection/sterilization and storage.

title: HSPA — Certified Healthcare Leader
evidence: Management domains include staffing, finance, compliance and communication. Page announces October 2026 eligibility changes while retaining old text; profile deliberately does not state experience eligibility.

title: HSPA — Who We Are
evidence: Association offers education, professional development, certification and advocacy for sterile-processing personnel.

title: BLS — Surgical Assistants and Technologists
evidence: Operating-room preparation and intraoperative assistance distinguish surgical technology from central processing.

title: BLS — Medical Equipment Repairers
evidence: Repairers install, maintain and repair patient-care equipment; distinguish from reprocessing.
